info.title: TechPulse AI API
info.description: Canonical HTTP contract for the Vietnamese-first TechPulse AI MVP. Browser API access is same-origin only; external content is untrusted data; no response contains source full text or media binary.

servers.description: Same-origin API. Production sends no CORS allow-origin/credentials headers; any future exception requires an exact reviewed scheme+host allowlist.

cookieAuth.name: __Host-techpulse_session
cookieAuth.description: Opaque server-side session token. The cookie is host-only and always emitted with Secure, HttpOnly, Path=/ and SameSite=Lax; Domain is forbidden. Every cookie-authenticated mutation also passes the exact same-origin browser Origin gate and CSRF validation.

cronBearer.description: Vercel CRON_SECRET; never accepted from a browser session.

SetSessionCookie.description: Exactly __Host-techpulse_session=<opaque>; Path=/; Secure; HttpOnly; SameSite=Lax. Domain is absent and Max-Age never exceeds the session absolute expiry.

ClearSessionCookie.description: Expires __Host-techpulse_session with the same host-only Path=/, Secure, HttpOnly and SameSite=Lax tuple using Max-Age=0. Domain remains absent.

PrivateNoStore.description: Authenticated/session-bearing responses must not be stored by browser or shared caches.

VaryCookie.description: Response representation depends on the session cookie.

BrowserOriginHeader.name: Origin
BrowserOriginHeader.description: Browser origin. Production requires an exact normalized scheme+host+effective-port match with the configured public application origin; suffix, wildcard and reflected matching are forbidden.

CsrfTokenHeader.name: X-CSRF-Token
CsrfTokenHeader.description: Session-bound CSRF token. The common browser ingress also requires an exact same-origin Origin value on every cookie-authenticated mutation.

IdempotencyKeyHeader.name: Idempotency-Key
IdempotencyKeyHeader.description: Scoped by authenticated actor/session and canonical request hash. Reusing a key for a different intent returns 409 idempotency_mismatch. The guarantee is 24 hours for grounded answers and at least 14 days for manual job/governance mutations; scheduled identities remain deterministic by target and period.

CursorQuery.name: cursor
CursorQuery.description: Opaque cursor; clients must not parse it.

MaintenanceTaskNamePath.name: taskName
MaintenanceTaskNamePath.description: Closed server-owned task name. It maps to one collection/state/deadline predicate and a maximum batch of 100.

Forbidden.description: Insufficient permission or invalid CSRF token

error.message: Insufficient permission or invalid CSRF token

Conflict.description: State, duplicate, lease, or idempotency conflict

error.message: State, duplicate, lease, or idempotency conflict

PayloadTooLarge.description: Request target or JSON payload exceeds the global ingress limit

UnsupportedMediaType.description: JSON route requires application/json with identity content encoding

error.message: Unsupported request content type or encoding

Retry-After.description: Seconds until a retry may succeed

HttpsUrl.description: Canonical HTTPS URL without username/password credentials. Runtime validation must parse with URL semantics; pattern matching alone is not sufficient.

AdminReasonCode.description: Non-sensitive allowlisted category. Each operation accepts only its documented/domain-allowed subset; free-form case text is never copied into audit logs.

AuditReasonCode.description: Safe audit category. System-derived values are never accepted from browser admin-reason inputs.

PublicArtifactStatus.description: removed is an internal/admin lifecycle state and is never serialized on public article responses.

csrfToken.description: Send in X-CSRF-Token for state-changing session-authenticated requests.

sessionsDeleted.description: True only after a direct indexed delete and zero-match verification for all session documents owned by the deleted user. TTL cleanup is not evidence.

answerAttemptsDeleted.description: True only after every PII-safe grounded-answer attempt receipt owned by the user is directly deleted and zero-match verified.

userQuotaDataDeleted.description: True only after user-scoped Q&A quota buckets are deleted and verified. Shared IP anti-abuse buckets are deliberately excluded.

identityAnonymized.description: True only after the raw user tombstone contains no identity, role, preference or moderation fields outside the closed lifecycle allowlist.

AccountDeletion.description: Automatic durable account deletion. It is separate from publisher/content takedown and completes only after direct session deletion, user-quota cleanup and every other cleanup flag are verified.

AccountDeletionAccepted.description: The deletion request is durable and all sessions are revoked before the 202 response is serialized; physical session-document deletion is asynchronous cleanup and remains false until verified.

AccountDeletionListResponse.description: Admin operational view without email, chat content or other deleted identity data.

LeadMedia.description: Remote media metadata only. Images may use remote-preview when source policy permits; video is link-only in the MVP. Binary media is never returned or stored by TechPulse AI.

attribution.description: Sanitized canonical display value resolved server-side from media credit, source attributionText, or source name.

summaryParagraphsVi.description: Detailed Vietnamese article summary. Null until the canonical rich-summary artifact is ready. The server also enforces a 6000-character aggregate limit.

AnswerScope.description: At least one of articleId, topics, or a time-bounded topic query must be supplied.

AnsweredAnswer.description: Every paragraph has at least one citation ID. Before persistence, the server resolves IDs against the visible retrieved evidence set and requires a conservative support verdict for the exact internal evidence-block IDs; those internal block IDs are not part of the public response.

Answer.description: Answered and refused responses are mutually exclusive contract states. Citation URLs are resolved by the server, never accepted from the model.

ChatSessionDetail.description: Public bounded history for the authenticated owner. messageCount equals the persisted messages length and never exceeds 30; the server enforces the equality before serialization. No owner identity, raw evidence, provider state, prompt, score, vector, credential or token is public.

ChatSessionMessage.description: Mutually exclusive persisted user question, answered assistant message or refused assistant message.

AnsweredChatMessage.description: Historical answered assistant message. Every paragraph citation ID resolves to one returned HistoricalChatCitation.id; citations may be available or unavailable after policy/takedown changes.

ReviewedMediaHostname.description: Canonical lowercase public DNS hostname reviewed in Source Registry. IP literals, localhost/single-label hosts, credentials and URL fragments are forbidden; IDN hosts are stored as A-labels. Runtime validation also rejects private/special-use resolution.

MediaPolicy.description: Display permission is independent from text storage and LLM input rights. The MVP never downloads or rehosts source media.

TechnicalCheck.description: Server-owned technical evidence. passed requires timestamp, host, content type, a positive sample count and no error.

SourceReconciliation.description: Durable source-owned marker. Step 3 persists pending state atomically with policy change; Step 9 materializes and completes bounded reconciliation work.

health.description: Redacted operational health only; never contains response bodies, credentials or full source text.

mediaPolicy.description: Optional on draft creation; the server defaults to imageMode=none, videoMode=none and an empty host allowlist.

SourceCreateRequest.description: Connector type, access method, authority tier and config are one discriminated unit; contradictory combinations are invalid.

SourceUpdateRequest.description: At least one mutable field besides reasonCode is required. The server must merge this patch with current source state and validate the complete Source Policy; activating a source is rejected unless technical and policy preconditions pass. Runtime domain validation returns 422 when reasonCode does not match the changed field set.

PolicyReviewRequest.description: If rights are unclear, choose metadata-only. The server owns reviewedBy/reviewedAt. Technical check or AI output cannot approve this review.

expectedSourcePolicyVersion.description: Source policy/config version captured before external fetch and required by the final article/checkpoint transaction.
Server-captured Source Policy version that must still match when an AI artifact or reconciliation result commits.

CronRun.description: Aggregate bounded-run result. Detailed jobs remain available through their admin queue endpoints.

MaintenanceRunResponse.description: Safe aggregate only; no document payload, caller-supplied predicate or internal cursor is serialized.

MaintenanceTaskName.description: Fixed server-owned maintenance action; it never carries a collection, filter, cutoff, cursor or batch-size override.

AdminArticle.description: Safe admin article summary. Removed articles use the metadata-free tombstone branch.

AdminArticleRemoved.description: Closed metadata-free article tombstone. Title, URL, author, provenance, topics, media and AI artifacts are forbidden.

AdminArticleDetail.description: Safe admin article detail. Removed articles expose only the metadata-free tombstone.

AdminArticleDetailActive.description: Safe admin diagnostics only. Excludes excerpt/full text, vectors, provider payloads, private chat and secrets.

AdminArticleUpdateRequest.description: At least one of status, topics or leadMediaStatus is required. Runtime domain validation returns 422 when reasonCode does not match the changed field set. Restoring media requires a current source policy that still permits its mode and host. Removed article restoration is subject to takedown policy.

HistoricalCitationUnavailable.description: Redacted historical citation. originalUrl, titleOriginal and publishedAt are intentionally forbidden by additionalProperties=false.

HistoricalChatCitation.description: Persistence/serialization contract for citations retained in historical chat after source-policy or takedown changes.

historicalChatCitationsRedacted.description: True only after every historical citation for the target is converted to the unavailable shape or absence is verified.

TakedownRequest.description: Takedown detail before requester PII retention expiry or after the terminal PII fields are purged. The post-purge branch is terminal-only and contains no requester PII.

decisionReasonCode.description: Allowlisted administrative transition reason. Free-form administrative decision text is not persisted or serialized.
Allowlisted administrative transition reason. Free-form administrative decision text is not persisted or serialized.

TakedownRequestPostPurge.description: Terminal takedown detail after requester PII fields are unset. Requester name/contact, reason and evidenceNote are forbidden.

TakedownUpdateRequest.description: MVP decisions are all-or-nothing. approved covers the complete requestedScope; completed requires every corresponding cleanup check. Account deletion is a separate workflow.

TakedownSummary.description: PII-minimized list item. Requester contact, reason and evidence are available only from the detail operation.

AdminUser.description: Deleted users serialize only opaque lifecycle identity; email and role are null because the persisted tombstone removes identity, preference and moderation fields.

AuditStateTransition.description: Only allowlisted non-sensitive lifecycle states are accepted; never store arbitrary field values.

AuditLog.description: Safe structured audit event. actorType=user records a user-initiated workflow such as account deletion using only an opaque actorId. Raw documents, PII, secrets, session data, private chat, provider payload and source content are forbidden before persistence and serialization.

ErrorCode.description: Stable machine-readable taxonomy. Operations may document a narrower subset; clients must not branch on message text.
